title: Vapouriz 50/50 Mango & Raspberry 10ml
description: Mango & Raspberry from the Vapouriz 50/50 collection is an outrageously moreish fruit cocktail, with bright, juicy notes of fresh, sun-ripened mangoes paired with the ruby, sharp tang of luscious raspberries. It’s a little bit tropical, a little bit English meadow, and a hugely delicious vape that will appeal to any fan of fruit blends. Vapouriz 50/50 takes some of the classic flavours from Vapouriz Premium’s bestselling collection of e-liquids, adds several new equally unique and delicious flavours, and bottles them in a smooth and satisfying 50% Vegetable Glycerine / 50% Propylene Glycol ratio. This ideal balance provides a deliciously flavoursome vape, with a discreet amount of vapour and a silky, comfortable throat hit. When it comes to vaping, 50/50 e-liquids really do offer the best of all worlds. All e-liquids contain Propylene Glycol (PG) and Vegetable Glycerine (VG) in various ratios. PG carries flavour the best and provides a tactile ‘throat hit’ that vapers are familiar with from smoking, while VG is the ingredient that aids vapour production. But since 50/50 e-liquids carry equal quantities of both, every vape you take is a deliciously flavoursome experience that produces a satisfying, yet not excessive, amount of vapour, while being comfortable on the throat. 50/50 e-liquids are among the most versatile e-liquids available, and can be used in most vape kits. However, 50/50 e-liquids perform best in low-resistance devices such as Starter Vape Kits, Pen Vape Kits and Pod Vape Kits.
